result.summary: The intersection provides essential pedestrian infrastructure, including sidewalks, curb ramps, and signalized crossings. The residential setting features mature trees and clear sightlines, though the wide corner radii may encourage faster vehicle turns.

hazards.name: Wide corner radius
hazards.description: The corner design allows for higher-speed vehicle turns, increasing risk to pedestrians at the crossing.

hazards.name: Unmarked crosswalks
hazards.description: Only one leg of the intersection has a clearly marked high-visibility crosswalk, potentially reducing driver awareness on other legs.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to reduce crossing distance and slow turning traffic by tightening the corner radius.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Mark all legs of the intersection with continental-style crosswalks to improve pedestrian visibility.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval
interventions.description: Program the traffic signal to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before vehicles receive a green light.

result.summary: The intersection features a marked zebra crosswalk and curb ramps, providing basic pedestrian access at a signalized junction. However, the lack of visible pedestrian signal heads and the presence of high industrial fencing along the sidewalk create a somewhat isolated environment for walking.

hazards.name: Missing Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible at the signalized intersection, requiring pedestrians to rely on vehicle signals.
hazards.location_in_image: At the intersection corners where signals are mounted.

hazards.name: Unprotected Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross the entire roadway width without a median or refuge island, increasing exposure to traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway at the zebra crosswalk.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information on when it is safe to cross.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to reduce the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The image shows a mixed-use urban intersection with basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks and a faded zebra-style crosswalk. The environment lacks modern safety features such as ADA-compliant curb ramps, pedestrian signals, or high-visibility markings, and the building placement at the corner may limit sightlines.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk
hazards.description: The zebra-style crosswalk markings are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.

hazards.name: Lack of Curb Ramps
hazards.description: There are no visible sloped transitions from the sidewalk to the roadway, creating a significant barrier for people with mobility aids or strollers.
hazards.location_in_image: Corner of the sidewalk near the deli

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: The building is situated directly at the property line on the corner, and parked vehicles on the side street may obscure pedestrians waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Corner of the green building and the side street to the right

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Repaint the crossing with high-visibility continental markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install ADA-compliant curb ramps with detectable warning surfaces at all crossing points.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance, improve sightlines, and slow turning traffic.

result.summary: The intersection provides basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks and a marked zebra crosswalk on one leg. However, the wide roadway and lack of modern safety features like curb extensions or visible pedestrian signals create an environment with significant exposure for those crossing.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide expanse of the roadway increases the time pedestrians are exposed to vehicle traffic.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles near the corner may block the view between drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image along the curb near the crosswalk

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility at the intersection corners.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking near the intersection to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.

interventions.description: Add dedicated pedestrian signals with countdown timers to provide clear crossing information.
